title: Conversation debug info is a developer option
steps: Launch a Debug build with -UseFakeData, open a conversation, press ⌘K and type debug
In Settings › Advanced › Developer options, turn on Show debugging tools
Press ⌘K and type debug again, then open the Help menu
expected: Copy debug info for this conversation and Save debug info to a file… are missing until the option is on, then show in the command palette and the Help menu. Nothing about the mail changes.
